title: Lost Mary Nera15k Blueberry Raspberry Ice Prefilled Vape Pods
description: Designed for use with the Lost Mary Nera30K Fullview Prefilled Pod Kit, the Lost Mary Nera15K Prefilled Pods offer a seamless, flavour-packed vaping experience with up to 15,000 puffs per refill pack. Each replacement pod pack includes a 2ml built-in mesh coil pod prefilled with Lost Mary’s signature nic salt e-liquid (20mg), plus an innovative 10ml auto-refilling e-liquid container that keeps your pod topped up for longer-lasting satisfaction. Blueberry Raspberry Ice blends the bold, tangy flavour of mixed berries with a cool, icy exhale. The deep, juicy notes of ripe Blueberry and Raspberry are perfectly complemented by a crisp, refreshing Menthol finish, making for a revitalising and satisfying vape. With a simple push-to-refill system, an easy e-liquid monitoring window, and advanced mesh coil technology, the Lost Mary Nera15K Prefilled Pods ensure consistently rich flavour and a smooth mouth-to-lung (MTL) vape. How to Use: 1. Remove all packaging and protective film. 2. Separate the 2ml prefilled pod and 10ml refill container. 3. Push the refill container into the pod until it clicks securely. 4. Attach the pod to your Nera30K device and remove the silicone plug from the mouthpiece. 5. Vape and enjoy. Once the e-liquid runs out, simply swap in a new Nera15K pod pack from a selection of 20 incredible Lost Mary flavour profiles.
